notes_for_editor: Stub, low confidence, and the location is doubtful. The tnlandforms entry cites datasheet EE1922, but NGS describes EE1922 as a 1972 triangulation disk stamped WARMACK in Whitfield County, at about 34 57 28.51 N, 084 51 37.31 W. That is far from the record's point (34.86662, -83.95582). Either the citation is a copy error or the list's coordinates are off. Check the location on a map and against a field source before publishing a map pin. No Wellborn tower appears in the NHLR or FFLOS Georgia lists. Wikipedia's Wellborn, Georgia URL returned 404. Union County history pages read (a Union Sentinel reprint and the Early Settlers blog, plus an N-Georgia forest history page) mention Brasstown Bald's tower and CCC work but not this site. The story is well under the 120-word target.
